items.title: MarShawn Lloyd: Eight touches in Jacobs' return
items.text:
Lloyd tallied six carries for 20 yards and two catches (on two targets) for 15 yards during Sunday's 20-17 loss in Detroit.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Much more effective as receiver
items.text:
Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards and brought in all eight targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Records second TD of season
items.text:
Kraft compiled four catches (on six targets) for 48 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 20-17 loss at Detroit.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Six catches in Week 7 loss
items.text:
Bowers secured six of eight targets for 73 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Makes six catches Sunday
items.text:

items.title: Kyren Williams: Tallies 121 scrimmage yards, TD in win
items.text:
Williams rushed 16 times for 99 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for 22 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
